blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — At least 1,100 security personnel were deployed across Bukidnon on Sunday, Nov. 1, to enforce safety guidelines and El Niño fire prevention measures as crowds flocked to cemeteries for Undas 2026. Personnel from the Bukidnon Police Provincial Office, the Bureau of Fire Protection, the provincial Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (DRRMO), Traffic Management Center, and Barangay Police Auxiliary Teams maintained a round-the-clock presence at memorial parks, churches, transit terminals, and major thoroughfares. In Valencia City, cemetery-goers began arriving as early as 6 a.m., carrying flowers, candles, and food to pay their respects to departed loved ones and […]...
